name: Ritech International AG
description:
Ritech Group is a Swiss-based software development and digital transformation company headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
It specializes in AI-powered solutions, full-stack development, cloud services, and advanced technologies like machine learning and computer vision.
The company operates globally with delivery centers in Europe, North America, and the Balkans, including Prishtina.
It helps businesses build scalable digital products by combining design, engineering, and AI innovation.

name: amberTech GmbH
description:
amberTech is a German AI software company based in Aachen.
It develops enterprise search and AI solutions that help companies access internal knowledge quickly and efficiently.
The platform uses AI to connect and understand company data across different systems.
It mainly serves SMEs and improves productivity through smarter knowledge management.

name: Intes GmbH
description:
INTES GmbH is a Swiss-based software development and consulting company.
It specializes in digital transformation, web development, and custom software solutions.
The company also provides services in automation, data, and AI-driven systems for businesses.
Its Kosovo branch works with international teams on software engineering projects.

name: IRTECH GmbH
description:
IR-Technology GmbH is a Switzerland-based company specializing in industrial equipment for the automotive and manufacturing sectors.
It provides solutions such as paint booths, drying systems, and related technical installations.
The company also offers maintenance, installation, and after-sales technical support.
It works with professional workshop and industrial clients across Europe.

name: LinkPlus IT
description:
It builds custom web and mobile applications for international clients.
The company mainly works in outsourced software engineering and IT services.
It serves businesses across Europe and the US with scalable tech solutions.

name: Ipko LLC
description:
IPKO is one of the leading telecommunications companies in Kosovo.
It provides mobile, internet, TV, and fixed-line communication services to both individual and business customers.
The company is known for its strong network infrastructure and wide coverage across the country.
It also supports various digital and IT projects in Kosovo’s telecom and tech sector.

name: Baron
description:
Baron Wedding Dresses is a fashion brand that designs and creates bridal and formal gowns.
It is known for custom-designed wedding dresses shared under its name on social media platforms.
The brand focuses on elegant, made-to-order bridal wear for special occasions.
It serves clients looking for personalized and designer-style wedding gowns.

name: Opoware
description: Austrian web agency building websites/e-stores and custom themes/plugins for clients across multiple industries.

name: BlueEcom
description:
Blueecom is a technology company focused on building software products and digital applications.
It develops AI-powered platforms, enterprise tools, and consumer-facing apps.
The company works on creating innovative digital solutions to improve user experiences and business operations.
It operates in the software development and AI innovation space.

name: Dukes LLC
description: Dukes LLC (previously known as Beneshtarg AG) was a digital services company based in Prishtina, working primarily for neundenker.ch (also known as konzeptler.ch) — a Swiss agency serving 600+ clients. The company handled development, hosting and delivery of Craft CMS-based websites for Swiss clients, combining technical execution with digital marketing services.

name: Freelance
description: Independent freelance practice delivering responsive websites and frontend development for a range of small business clients.

name: Tribes Digital Ltd
description:
Tribes Digital Ltd is a UK-registered software development and AI-powered digital delivery company.
It specializes in end-to-end product engineering, combining design, development, QA, and cloud services.
The company uses AI to accelerate software delivery and improve engineering quality and efficiency.
It works with global clients and operates with distributed teams across multiple regions, including Europe and the Balkans.
